titleEn: Product suggestions after an order (template message)
screens: BotScreen Product suggestions after an order

ar: عايز ابعت للعميل منتجات تعجبه بعد ما يطلب
ازاي اشغّل ترشيح المنتجات بعد الطلب؟
ليه ترشيح المنتجات بعد الطلب مقفول؟
en: Can I send customers product suggestions after they order?

steps: Get a MARKETING template approved by Meta with two body variables: customer name and product list
Settings > Bot > Product suggestions after an order: enter the approved template name and save
Turn on the switch (owner only; off by default)
edgeCases: Sent only when the template is APPROVED, the customer has explicit marketing consent and no STOP, it is outside 21:00-09:00 shop time, and the customer had none in the last 14 days
Charged to the wallet per message; nothing is held while the switch is off or any condition is false
Every skip is recorded on the order with its reason
gaps: Store checkout consent wording does not yet name product suggestions; keep the switch off until it does (Ruling CHAT-RECS-SWITCH-1)
assistantNote: it is a message the store starts and it costs wallet credit; never turn it on for the owner without the approved template name
